profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Mobile at Kikoff
profile.summary:
I have been working on iOS since 2010. Over the years, I created new apps for the App Store like Prima AFP, UPC Movil, Tarjeta Oh or Selfied. Also, I got the opportunity to build new features over already created apps like Facebook or WhatsApp (iOS: Stickers, Disappearing Messages, etc), as well as for YouTube creating and improving new formats for internals campaigns.

Most of my experience is as iOS developer, but I got some additional positions like project manager or team manager.
